prompts.authority_limits: May validate and structure supplied mandate; may not supply missing decision thresholds.
required_analysis: Extract transaction context, objectives, constraints, thresholds, diligence and reviewers
evidence_rules: Mandate facts cite the supplied mandate
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent purchase price, return, leverage or liquidity thresholds.
prompts.role_boundary: Normalizes input; does not research or recommend.

prompts.authority_limits: May define questions, evidence standards and selected workstreams within mandate.
required_analysis: Cover Blocks A, B and C
evidence_rules: Use primary/replayable evidence for material claims
counterevidence_rules: Every module gets an adverse-evidence requirement
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not pre-write findings or gate outcomes.
prompts.role_boundary: Defines the research obligation; does not execute research.

prompts.authority_limits: Sequences only the approved workflow and dependencies.
output_contract: Ordered research plan with module dependencies
evidence_rules: No stage advances without its business gate
counterevidence_rules: Plan explicit downside and counterevidence work
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not skip gates or substitute PCE for business criteria.
prompts.role_boundary: Planner does not evaluate modules or control retries after a failure.
